decisions.reason: The superfood drink mix is a low-investment consumer side line that is only mentioned on the website, so dropping it would cost little, but as part of the established offer it is cheap to keep in a firm that already runs many small ventures.
The modular plant extensions extend the established waste-to-energy offer across several models, so the engineering already sunk into them and their fit with the core business favor keeping them.

The waste oil to energy plant is a publicly presented flagship with its own web page and high engineering investment, so dropping it would write off that investment and expose the announced direction as a mistake, and early weak results can still be blamed on a long sales cycle.

The plastic waste to fuel plant is announced as a flagship of the firm's direction and has absorbed substantial investment, so escalation of commitment favors continuing it despite its lower web visibility.
